name: Zone Cleaners
summary:
The core idea of the game is to enter dangerous zones with 2–4 entities, each level featuring unique challenges. Players collect energy orbs scattered throughout the zones, which are used as ammo for guns and gadgets. The goal is to defeat powerful, unique monsters.
